opening.argument: The presentation is centered on COVID-19 public-health education. The title frames the subject as correct and wrong understandings of the disease, while the speaker explains symptoms, what to do when they appear, isolation for mild cases, and preventive precautions. Displayed case and symptom figures reinforce that explanatory focus. Proceum branding and a website appear as source attribution, but the material does not establish a request for payment, credentials, or participation in a deceptive scheme. The observable content supports an educational purpose without establishing any such solicitation or outcome.

citations.quote: Corona Virus Disease / Kovid -19: About the correct and wrong angles (Hindi) - Part 1
If someone has all these symptoms, what should you do next? You should first call this helpline number and tell them about your symptoms.
If you have mild symptoms, you will be isolated in a special ward. Where you will be monitored and given symptomatic treatment.
Keep your hands clean with a sanitizer or soap every 3-4 hours.
